empirical_claims: Coates & Clack 1990: Acanthostega forelimb has eight digits; Ichthyostega hindlimb has seven.
Daeschler, Shubin & Jenkins 2006: Tiktaalik has lepidotrichia and no digits (Frasnian, 375 Ma).
Turing 1952 and Murray 1981: a diffusion-driven instability selects a finite wavenumber k_c when the inhibitor diffuses sufficiently faster than the activator.

Porro, Rayfield & Clack 2015: the Acanthostega skull roof carries dermal ornament (pits and ridges). That ornament is millimetre-scale; this loop does not treat it as a measured 105 µm pigment spacing.

reported_in_source: Eight digits in Acanthostega and seven in Ichthyostega (Coates & Clack 1990).
Tiktaalik is a finned elpistostegalian without digits (Daeschler, Shubin & Jenkins 2006).
The Turing critical-wavenumber formula and the Schnakenberg kinetics.
reconstructed_in_script: Du calibrated so analytic lambda_c = 104.9 µm at r = 10, a = 0.05, b = 1.
Fin-ray anisotropy alpha = 3.4 and the Ichthyostega Dv factor 0.92.
Digit-corridor width 4.2 mm (40 wavelengths of 105 µm).
transfer_boundary: The 105 µm scale is the campaign primordium tier applied to this animal, not a published melanosome measurement.
does_not_claim: That fossil melanosomes or dermal pits of Acanthostega were measured at 105 µm.
That the Schnakenberg field is a pixel reconstruction of the skull.
That alpha = 3.4 or the 0.92 factor was read off a specimen with calipers.
